## Project Overview

This website analyzes Drake's historic music career by bringing together multi-source data across Billboard chart longevity, cross-platform DSP distribution, and global Spotify streaming numbers.

## Data Sources & Links

1. **Spotify Top Songs Tracker (kworb.net):**
   - Catalog of 547 charted songs tracking over **140.7 billion all-time Spotify streams** and 65.9 million daily streams.
   - Sourced from [kworb.net Spotify Artist Tracker](https://kworb.net/spotify/artist/3TVXtAsR1Inumwj472S9r4_songs.html).

2. **Songstats Cross-Platform DSP Monitoring:**
   - Real-time catalog distribution and metadata for the track titled **"Drake"** by Alsago & Slight Shady across 184 country markets.
   - Sourced from [Songstats](https://songstats.com/track/ul9j1yr4/drake).

3. **Billboard Hot 100 Historical Archive (TidyTuesday):**
   - **2,569 weekly observations** tracing every song where Drake was credited as a lead artist or featured performer between 2009 and 2021.
   - Sourced from the official [TidyTuesday Billboard repository](https://github.com/rfordatascience/tidytuesday/tree/master/data/2021/2021-09-14).

4. **Billboard Official Artist Chart History:**
   - Historical chart peak positions and weeks at #1.
   - Sourced from [Billboard.com Drake Chart History](https://www.billboard.com/artist/drake/chart-history/).
